description: Lint a Lottie (Bodymovin) animation. Pass `json` as the text of the .json file. Checks: valid JSON with the expected top-level fields (v, fr, ip, op, w, h, layers), text size (over about 100 KB is heavy for UI, over 500 KB is very heavy; conventions), layer count including pre-compositions, expressions (unsupported on several native players), embedded base64 images, masks, mattes, blend modes, 3D layers, text layers and effects (patchily supported on mobile players), frame rate (above 60 is wasted; above 30 rarely needed for UI), duration, and canvas size. dotLottie (.lottie zip) files are not supported; unzip first.
name: lint_lottie_json
title: Lottie JSON lint
